targets.recommendedConfirmation: ONE_SEPARATE_ORIGINAL_REQUEST_REQUIRED; V4 question explicitly changes identity/tie policy. Preserve old strict verdict even when disagreement is only old tie membership.

targets.originalQuestion: 2017 年和 2018 年各有多少笔订单？
targets.originalGoldSql:
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::INT AS yr, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM orders
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) IN (2017, 2018)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
targets.recommendedConfirmation: REUSE_UNIQUE_FINAL_DEVELOPMENT_RESPONSE; execute original Gold and original strict shape/unit/order criterion separately, never copy the V4 verdict.
targets.conflict: No substantive contract conflict. Two rows (year,count), integer year, chronological order; no pivot or extra columns.

targets.originalQuestion: 复购率是多少？（下单 2 次及以上的用户占全部下单用户的比例）
targets.originalGoldSql:
WITH per_user AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_cnt >= 2) / COUNT(*), 2) AS repeat_rate_pct
FROM per_user;
targets.recommendedConfirmation: QUESTION_UNCHANGED_BUT_GOLD_TEXT_CHANGED_NULLIF_AND_FORMAT; preregister reuse only if the ORIGINAL strict adjudicator/Gold is independently retained and applied to the unique response. If A protocol defines byte-identical Gold as mandatory, use ONE separate original request. Resolve this before freezing; never choose after observing the answer.
targets.conflict: Registered repeat_rate is PERCENT, scale 2. Generic word 比例 does not override registered units. Old Gold lacks NULLIF, V3 adds it; empty-denominator boundary differs, so byte equality is false and must be disclosed.
